verdict.rationale: The evidence documents `remember()` as a single-call ingestion entry point that chunks data and builds the graph. Nothing in the pack mentions async or background processing, batch ingestion at scale, or any way to check the status of background memory operations. This axis applies to a memory engine, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can ingest at scale with async or batch processing and check the status of background memory operations
